description: Canonical meaning, behavior, customer impact, and advisor interpretation of insurance concepts.
principle: This registry explains what an insurance term means and how it behaves. It is not a product fact store.

entries.definition: A percentage or amount of the admissible claim that the policyholder must bear.
entries.calculation_logic: Usually applied on admissible claim amount, not necessarily on total hospital bill.
entries.common_misunderstanding: Customer may assume co-pay is applied on total hospital bill or may underestimate out-of-pocket expense.
entries.customer_explanation: Co-pay means you will pay a part of the approved claim amount from your pocket.
entries.advisor_note: Explain whether co-pay applies on admissible claim amount, specific treatments, age bands, room category, or all claims.

entries.definition: A restriction on the hospital room category or daily room rent covered under the policy.
entries.calculation_logic: May be defined as a fixed amount, percentage of sum insured, or room category.
entries.common_misunderstanding: Customer may think only extra room rent is payable, but in some policies exceeding room eligibility may reduce other claim expenses.
entries.customer_explanation: Room rent limit decides what room category you can use without claim deductions.
entries.advisor_note: Always check whether exceeding room eligibility triggers proportionate deduction.

entries.definition: A claim deduction method where expenses may be reduced in proportion to the eligible room rent or room category.
entries.calculation_logic: If actual room rent exceeds eligible room rent, related expenses may be paid in the same ratio, depending on policy wording.
entries.common_misunderstanding: Customer may believe only the room rent difference is deducted.
entries.customer_explanation: Choosing a higher room than allowed can reduce multiple parts of your hospital claim, not just room rent.
entries.advisor_note: Flag this clearly for customers choosing lower sum insured plans or policies with room caps.

entries.definition: Waiting period after which declared pre-existing diseases become eligible for coverage, subject to policy terms.
entries.calculation_logic: Usually measured from policy inception or continuous coverage start date.
entries.common_misunderstanding: Customer may assume all illnesses are covered immediately after buying the policy.
entries.customer_explanation: Diseases you already had before buying the policy may be covered only after a waiting period.
entries.advisor_note: Check customer's medical history and compare PED waiting period across products.

entries.definition: Waiting period applicable to specific listed diseases or treatments, even if they are not pre-existing.
entries.calculation_logic: Usually disease-wise and measured from policy start date.
entries.common_misunderstanding: Customer may think only PED has waiting period and all new diseases are covered immediately.
entries.customer_explanation: Some treatments like cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc. may have separate waiting periods.
entries.advisor_note: Extract disease-wise table carefully and preserve table structure.

entries.definition: A benefit that restores or reinstates sum insured after it is exhausted, subject to policy conditions.
entries.calculation_logic: May apply once or multiple times, and may vary for same illness, different illness, same member, or different member.
entries.common_misunderstanding: Customer may assume restored sum insured can always be used for the same illness or same claim.
entries.customer_explanation: Restoration refills your cover after use, but conditions decide when and how it can be used.
entries.advisor_note: Identify whether restoration applies to same illness, related illness, same insured person, and first claim.

entries.definition: A specific cap on claim payment for a disease, treatment, procedure, room, or benefit within the overall sum insured.
entries.calculation_logic: May be fixed amount, percentage of sum insured, or plan-specific cap.
entries.common_misunderstanding: Customer may assume full sum insured is available for every treatment.
entries.customer_explanation: Even if your total cover is high, some treatments may have separate smaller limits.
entries.advisor_note: Highlight disease and procedure sub-limits during product comparison.
